title: Pacific Presbytery — Citation re: Review of Presbytery Records
disposition_detail: The SJC accepted Pacific Presbytery’s response to exceptions of substance, subject to certification that Presbytery had approved the response.
first_summary: Cited under BCO 40-5 concerning exceptions of substance in its records, Pacific Presbytery submitted a response that the SJC found acceptable, pending certification that Presbytery had approved it.
summary: Pacific Presbytery was cited under BCO 40-5 to provide a more acceptable response to exceptions of substance found during records review. The SJC accepted its response, conditioned on certification to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records that Presbytery had approved it. The decision gives no further substantive rationale and, unlike rulings concerning three other presbyteries considered collectively, does not direct that Pacific’s minutes be forwarded.

sources.supports: Case identity, collective adoption, BCO 40-5 citation, exceptions of substance, conditional acceptance, and the separate forwarding of other presbyteries’ minutes.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: Lines 29–33 identify 2010-23 and state that the SJC considered the cited cases collectively; lines 55–59 record adoption.
evidence_notes.dispute: Lines 37–47 state that Pacific was cited under BCO 40-5 to seek a more acceptable response to exceptions of substance.
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: Lines 49–53 accept Pacific’s response pending certification of Presbytery approval; no further rationale is stated.
evidence_notes.qualifications: Lines 51–53 distinguish conditional acceptance of Pacific’s response from forwarding minutes submitted by three other presbyteries.

source_limits: The combined administrative decision does not describe the underlying exceptions of substance or explain why Pacific’s response was acceptable.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: Identifies the BCO 40-5 citation and exceptions-of-substance response.
score_reasons.decision: States both acceptance and its certification condition.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Faithfully notes that no further rationale was supplied.
score_reasons.distinctive_value: Preserves the conditional nature of acceptance and distinguishes relief applying only to other presbyteries.
score_reasons.fidelity: Separates Pacific’s ruling from collectively reported outcomes for other presbyteries.
score_reasons.economy: Retains only facts needed to explain the issue, result, and limitation.

verification_notes: Rechecked lines 47–53 and corrected the collective ruling to isolate Pacific’s outcome: its response was conditionally accepted, while the direction forwarding minutes applied only to Korean Northwest, Korean Southeastern, and Korean Southwest Presbyteries.
